provenance.asset_description: Illustration by Jose Parodi: Pallomar Gladhammer, a half-orc man. His Varisian attire includes an open blouse with full sleeves, an open vest with a high collar, and voluminous pants tucked into boots. His headscarf, belt, and bracelets are decorated with multiple metallic discs. He has his arms out in a welcoming manner and looks jovial
